technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Generic ISL process with overall uranium recovery of 75%. Assumed depth of ore body is 120m and assumed vertical dimension of ore body is 15m. Assumed hexagonal injection field with 20m grid edge and central production well.

# Included processes
Uranium production and mining site underground remediation. Process energy for pumping. Sulfuric acid and water consumption. Piping material consumption. Isolation of pollutant concentrate during remediation. Landfilling of isolate.
